name: ai.plune/cli
title: Plune
description: Plune test management for agents: review queue, test cases, missions, strategy and reports.

environmentVariables.name: PLUNE_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Plune API token. Without it, the login saved by `plune login` is used. A read token offers only the read tools.

environmentVariables.name: PLUNE_PROJECT
environmentVariables.description: Project the tools work in. Without it, the token's own project.
